description: Claude Code plugins by penso-technology: live UI mods and hooks.

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Draws the context window as a stacked bar above the prompt, one colour per /context category; /context-bar toggles it.

plugins.name: model-limits
plugins.description: Publishes the per-model weekly rate-limit windows (Fable, ...) to ~/.claude/model-limits.json for a status line script to draw.
